verdict.rationale: Whisper ships as an open-source model you install and run locally (pip install, CLI and Python transcription), so audio can be processed on your own hardware without going to OpenAI. Community reports of whisper.cpp running on local devices support this. However, nothing in the evidence explicitly states a no-training data policy or a training opt-out for the hosted API, so the privacy guarantee is only implied by local execution. Missing for 10: explicit documented data-usage/no-training policy, opt-out controls for the hosted transcription API, confirmation of no telemetry in local runs.
